bestBets.overview: For the first time this prep, TEMPRANILLO is likely to see ground better than heavy. That H10 last time didn't look to be suiting her. Efforts prior were solid enough but it is significant that her two wins are on good ground.  Somewhere in that soft5-6 range should help. After having her races spaced earlier this season, BAYWATCH is getting some continuity now and she is racing well. Her past couple have been on very heavy tracks and the prospect of improving soft ground appeals for her. Had LICENTIOUS drawn better she would be top pick. Carrying just 52kg is a huge advantage in this race. She's returned a much improved filly/new season mare. SAPPHIRE SIREN is an exciting prospect resuming. Fairly sure that going forward she'll be the best horse. 1st up 1600m with the weight is a test but so was jumping from 1400m to 2100m last time in.  MEH KEFFI next.

raceTips.comment: Sapphire Siren is lightly-raced with form around some good horses and although resuming, any market support should be respected. Eleanor Dumont may be better suited with a senior rider on board and also has upside. Baywatch finished ahead of some rivals last time while Licentious is in form and can figure in the finish.

bestBets.overview: The speed is unclear. There's no doubt Spring isn't far away when you see a 3yo like ZAMBALES tackle a 3yo maiden 1st up. Four of his past five starts have been in Gr 1 races. 4th in the Blue Diamond and Champagne are his best results in those races. He finished 2nd in the Gr 2 Sires Produce. He's trialled like a coming winner on heavy ground. Three new-comers are taking him on and all have jumped out very well. You'd mark any of them as the favourite in an ordinary maiden. Happy to let the market decide who was the best. SOMETHING'S BURNIN" and SHOOTING BRAKE  have good race-day form. The latter's 3rd to Natural Fling looks good after Saturday's win by that filly. I'm sure all of these 3yos will run well.

raceTips.comment: Zambales has form in some quality Group races last preparation and looked in excellent order in a recent jumpout. bestBets.overview: This maiden is for the fillies and it's a hot one too. Six new-comers in this one and wary of all. A couple have had a soft time of it. STIPULATION caught the eye but again, happy to be guided by the market. They'll need to be city class (at least) to defeat RESOLUTELY and GHANA'S AKAN. The former has been very good in both runs back. She didn't have much peace on speed last time. GHANA'S AKAN was out working 3-4wide in that race. She held on well under the circumstances and is sure to be fitter. When she finished 5th in the Blue Diamond she ran over the line with Zambales (R2 today). There's also some strong provincial maiden form. ALL THAT AND MORE was terrific at Sale behind Organised Crime who was narrowly beaten in the Vain on Saturday. There was a lot to like about SAINTLY DANCER'S Geelong debut. Given the Maher stable has four of them, including GHANA'S AKAN, the market movements will be fascinating.

raceTips.comment: Resolutely is ready to win following two seconds in as many starts this preparation and is the one to beat. All That And More hit the line exceptionally well on debut and has solid claims. Jinkies made a good impression on debut and will be better for the experience. Ghana'a Akan is another bright prospect.

bestBets.overview: A wide race. Doubt The Heath was DEVIL IN HER's track. Back to mares only and 2100m she's a hope but 61kg is definitely a challenging handicap. GIGGENBACH looks ready to win after two solid Winter runs at 1800m and 2100m against males. 12 months ago, you'd tip CHAMPAGNE JENNI confidently in a race like this. She's mixed it up since and swapped stables a few times. Her past two have been encouraging and we know she can stay. WINTER GRACE can stay but has to prove herself this grade.  BIG SISTER AVA had race shape against last time. Still working out what level she is. That was SHE'S A CON's first Australian win after being here for 3 years. She promised a lot but was mostly disappointing. Could she be one of those horses who gets a taste of victory and goes on with it. ALAMGO is going well. Back in March she ran here in a race like this and she wasn't far away. She was a $81 chance that day with a claiming apprentice. C Williams aboard is significant.

raceTips.comment: Soul Mistress was a deserved winner last time, can land on pace and could take some running down again. Ninyo was plain last time but impressed prior and merits consideration. Street Lark is yet to be proven over the trip but may find this easier, while Giggenbach might be ready to peak third up.

Will concede WOLFY is a tough one to trust winning but that effort in Sth Australia last time was unusually basic. There are a number of efforts prior to that which would see him go close in a race like this. At the double figure odds, he's worth including. QUEEN CHRISTINE is airborne. No knock on her. No surprise to see CYBER LINK fire fresh as a gelding and with blinkers first time. FARCITED next while DAMAS trialled brilliantly.

raceTips.comment: Star Trip was excellent second up challenging on inferior ground and might be ready to score third up. Primal Spirit has an excellent record at this course, while Farcited has had excuses on two runs back this preparaiton.
